pullRequests.title: fix(rac1): save real inventory during randomized NPC rewards
pullRequests.author: llesieur99
pullRequests.head: fix/rac1-npc-save-inventory
pullRequests.body:
Helga can request an autosave before her update returns, while the randomizer temporarily presents the Swingshot ownership byte as the location's collection state. That temporary value can be saved alongside the randomized reward. Archipelago uses the same substitutions, and its existing explicit-serialization guard can resume them too early when save calls are nested.

pullRequests.title: Show and animate actual Archipelago rewards at pickups and purchases
pullRequests.author: SavedbyBlood9
pullRequests.head: feat/archipelago-reward-presentation
pullRequests.body:
Randomized rewards now display and present the item actually received. For example, a Gold Bolt in the Pyrocitor vendor slot shows its Gold Bolt model, name and icon; leaving the vendor presents only the last purchased reward.

pullRequests.title: Item randomizer: present actual rewards at pickups and vendors
pullRequests.author: SavedbyBlood9
pullRequests.head: feat/item-randomizer-reward-presentation
pullRequests.body:
RAC1 shuffled vendors and world pickups show the actual reward's model, fitted name and inventory icon, with reward-based Gold Bolt, weapon demo and Infobot sequences. Vendors present only the last purchase on exit. NPC handoff scenes/models stay native while purchase prompts name the reward. Approved profiles come from the companion engine; no live editors or playtest utilities are included.
New RAC1 seeds also shuffle the 13 NPC coordinate rewards through the existing Shuffle Infobots switch.…

pullRequests.title: Item randomizer: add optional New Game+ start for RAC1
pullRequests.author: SavedbyBlood9
pullRequests.head: feat/item-randomizer-new-game-plus
pullRequests.body:
Adds a RAC1-only launcher setting, Start in New Game+ (start_in_new_game_plus), off by default. When enabled, a randomized save uses the retail New Game+ mode flag and Goodies menu, matching Archipelago's behavior without granting gold weapons or completed-save inventory.

pullRequests.body:

pullRequests.title: feat(rac1): add optional Items-menu pool to both randomizers
pullRequests.author: SavedbyBlood9
pullRequests.head: feat/rac1-items-menu-pool
pullRequests.body:
RAC1's Items category now has its own optional pool in both the item randomizer and Archipelago. Enabling Shuffle items (shuffle_items) adds all nine entries: Hoverboard, Persuader, Bolt Grabber, Map-o-Matic, Platinum Zoomerator, Raritanium, CodeBot, Premium Nanotech and Ultra Nanotech. It defaults off; off keeps all nine at their vanilla locations, independently of Shuffle gadgets.

pullRequests.author: farfeduc
pullRequests.head: feat/cheats-overlay
pullRequests.body:
cheats 0.4.0: the same switches and buttons as the pause page, in OpenRAC's own menu, at any time in the game. Still interface 1.12 and the pinned SDK; one commit on master.
Why
The cheats could only be switched from Pause > Options > Cheats, in a level. OpenRAC's in-game menu has listed mods' menus (developer_menu, interface 1.10) since #211, the menu shared by desktop and Android. It opens with Alt, Start+Select, or the drawer on a touch screen. commits.headline: fix(rac1): save real inventory during randomized NPC rewards (#192)
commits.author: llesieur99
commits.body:
Keep temporary NPC ownership substitutions out of saves in item randomizer and Archipelago. Hold the real inventory through nested preparation, autosave and serialization calls, then restore the collection view.

Regression tests fail before the fix and pass afterward. All 22 mod tests validated; maintainer NTSC purchase/save/reload and saved inventory check passed in an isolated prepared fixture. PAL and Archipelago gameplay remain unverified.
